html-to-image 1.11.13, MIT license (see LICENSE).
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/html-to-image/-/html-to-image-1.11.13.tgz
Upstream: https://github.com/bubkoo/html-to-image
Vendored ES modules; source map comments removed. Local webfont scanner patch reads
CSS in detached documents, follows imports without changing host stylesheets, and
applies fetchRequestInit to CSS as well as font requests. Built with our existing
esbuild, so deployment requires no npm installation or third-party CDN.
